title: I used AI to turn a text-heavy detective case into an interactive browser game — looking for honest feedback
author: Narrow-Decision5097
selftext:
I started this project as a roughly 20-page text-based detective case. During the first test, I realized that reading a long case file and then opening separate clues made the experience feel more like homework than a game.

Instead of abandoning the concept, I used AI as an implementation tool while I acted as the product director, editor, and primary playtester.

The project went through several iterations:

* The original document became an interactive browser experience.
* Visual evidence, suspect portraits, investigation notes, scoring, hints, and achievements were added.
* An early version was too easy, so the evidence chain and final accusation were expanded.
* One male character was incorrectly assigned a female system voice, so voice selection was redesigned.
* The original ambient sound felt flat and overwhelmed the dialogue, so separate volume controls and automatic audio ducking were added.
* The timer originally stopped incorrectly after leaving the page, and saved progress could not be fully reset. Both systems were revised and tested again.
* Some clues depended too much on assumed corporate or technical knowledge, so explicit evidence about credentials, permissions, and token duration was added.

AI assisted with the story drafts, code, graphics, audio design, debugging, and revisions. My role was to define the experience, test every version, identify where it failed, direct the changes, check the logic, and decide what was ready to publish. I did not simply publish the first generated output.

The current result is Ghost Code Public Beta 1.4, a free 30–45 minute interactive detective mystery playable in a browser. It contains 14 evidence files, four suspects, character audio, notes, optional hints, scoring, and a five-part final accusation.

I would especially like feedback from this community on:

* Which parts still feel generic or obviously AI-generated?
* Does the final deduction feel earned and logically supported?
* Where does the human direction or quality control still appear insufficient?
* Is the audio/visual presentation cohesive?
* Is this worth developing into additional paid cases?

Free browser playtest:  
[https://detective-league-studio.itch.io/ghost-code-public-playtest](https://detective-league-studio.itch.io/ghost-code-public-playtest)

The browser version is in English. The downloadable offline package includes English and Spanish.

Please avoid revealing the culprit or final answers publicly.
